contentPattern.structure: stat heading + short description (text-only tile, no image, no link)

suitableFor: text-only feature/benefit/stat tiles ('Why choose us' style grids)
3-up coloured highlight panels with a bold stat heading + supporting sentence
uniform benefit callouts with no image and no per-card CTA
notSuitableFor: photo teaser cards with image + title + description + read link (use cards-teaser)
icon + short label product/category link grids (use cards-product)

usage.notes: Car-insurance 'Why choose Admiral Car Insurance?' section: three dark-blue rounded stat tiles (We accept 98.9% of claims / Over 5 million vehicles covered / The Best Motor Insurer). Text-only cards - no images, no per-card links.
